summary: A Yes vote updates the Emergency Medical Services, Advanced Life Support, and Fire Protection special parcel tax and adds low-income exemptions and rebates, raising about $2.5 million per year until ended by voters.

tax.text: The League of Women Voters supports a Yes vote on Measure Q, which raises an estimated $2.5 million annually to maintain emergency medical and fire services.
tax.quote: Measure Q — Emergency Medical Services & Fire Protection Tax : SUPPORT
